```
['test the TimesFmModelForPrediction model with forecast and frequency inputs to verify prediction outputs', 'create a TimesFmConfig with patch, context, horizon lengths, quantiles, and hidden size parameters', 'test that eager and SDPA attention implementations produce matching TimesFM model outputs', 'test that the TimesFmModelForPrediction main input name matches the first parameter after self', 'test TimesFM model inference using the pretrained google/timesfm-2.0-500m-pytorch model checkpoint']
```

